messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 alert: KV cache eviction rate > 3000/s and continuous-batcher latency climbing. Error spike observed in hosted API (502s). Auto-escalation to on-call Maya.

maya: seeing it in dashboards — tail latency for short requests jumped from 15ms -> 400ms. Prefetch evictions are through the roof. Impacting bursty mixed-shape traffic.

juan: grabbing logs now. initial suspicion: prefetch loop + packer combining long + short requests causing pack starvation and KV thrash.

kay: linking recent perf cliff PRs — we rolled a change to packer heuristics last night (runtimes v2.8.3). Might be related.

maya: good call. rolling diag steps: 1) reduce continuous-batcher max_pack_size to 32, 2) disable aggressive prefetch for 20m, 3) scale kv-cache nodes + enable eviction-throttle.

ade: customer impact? Support: a few high-throughput customers reported increased 5xx. Working with top two (AcmeAnalytics, Widgetly) now.

juan: tail of logs from one node: ```
WARN kv_cache: eviction loop duration=1200ms items=10240 active_prefetches=48
ERROR batcher: packer_starve detected long-queue=12 short-queue=87
TRACE prefetcher: overlap_window=300ms attempts=6
```

maya: applying mitigation now — going to push hotfix to batcher config and disable prefetch via runtime flags. will post deploy bot output.

deploy-bot: maya triggered config-update: runtime.batch.max_pack=32, runtime.prefetch.enabled=false, runtime.kv.eviction_throttle=on — rolling to region-us-east-1.

deploy-bot: deploy started (canary 10%).

maya: monitoring canary. Metrics: within 2 mins canary latency for short requests dropped from 380ms -> 45ms. eviction rate reduced ~70%.

juan: confirming EVS logs show fewer concurrent prefetches. Good.

kay: quick note — the change to packer heuristics increased pack variance for mixed shape traffic; combined with the prefetch aggressiveness it created hot keys that triggered mass evictions. We should mark that PR for revert follow-up.

ade: I've notified AcmeAnalytics engineering and Widgetly support. initial SLI impact: Acme ~4% 5xx spike for 12 minutes, Widgetly ~2% for 9 minutes. Both on hosted tier.

maya: scaling kv-cache pool by +2 nodes to relieve pressure while we validate.

juan: metrics look stable after canary. promoting to 100% in 4m.

deploy-bot: deploy promoted to 100% (region-us-east-1).

maya: moving to post-incident triage — immediate mitigations applied: reduced pack size, disabled prefetch, enabled eviction throttle, +2 cache nodes. Customer impact summarized to product/support.

kay: action items: 1) revert/adjust packer heuristics PR (ENG-RUNTIME-432) — high priority, 2) add safety limit to prefetch concurrency, 3) add packer simulation tests for mixed-shape loads, 4) improve observability: per-tenant kv evictions.

ade: will send customer impact email draft and update incident page. Suggest offering credits to AcmeAnalytics given burst outage.

maya: handing off to next on-call Juan for 08:00-16:00. Summary: SEV2, root cause likely interaction of new packer heuristics + aggressive prefetch -> KV thrash and batcher starvation. Mitigations applied and stable. Next steps: (kay/eng-runtime) rollback PR + add throttles; (obs) add per-tenant eviction alerts.

juan: ack — I'll keep watch and escalate if any regression. Leaving a checklist in the incident doc.

pagerduty-bot: incident acknowledged by on-call: juan.

maya: thanks team. Marking incident as mitigated, keeping thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
